# Sirach Chapter 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 11 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_011_page_001.jpg

---

**11:1** The wisdom of the humble will lift up his head, and in the midst of great men he will take his seat.

**11:2** Do not praise a man for his appearance, and do not loathe a man for his outward form.

**11:3** Small among flying things is the bee, yet what it produces is the chief of sweet things.

**11:4** Do not boast about the clothing you wear, and do not exalt yourself in the day of your honor; for the works of the LORD are wondrous, and his deeds among men are hidden.

**11:5** Many kings have sat down upon the ground, and one who was not thought of has worn a crown.

**11:6** Many powerful men have been greatly disgraced, and men of renown have been handed over into the power of others.

**11:7** Before you investigate, do not find fault; examine first, and then reprove.

**11:8** Before you hear, do not answer, and in the midst of a speech do not interrupt.

**11:9** Do not dispute over a matter that does not concern you, and in the judgment of sinners do not sit.

**11:10** My child, do not busy yourself with many matters; if you multiply your affairs, you will not go unpunished; and if you pursue, you will not overtake, and you will not escape by fleeing.

**11:11** There is one who labors and toils and strains, and is all the more behind.

**11:12** There is one who is sluggish and lacks strength, who falls short in prosperity yet the eye of the LORD looks upon him for good, and he shakes him free from his lowly condition.

**11:13** And he lifts his head and many are amazed at him.

**11:14** Good things and evil, life and death, poverty and wealth — they are from the LORD.

**11:15** The gift of the LORD remains with the godly, and his favor brings success everlasting.

**11:16** There is one who grows rich through his careful attention, and this is the portion of his reward.

**11:17** There is one who becomes poor through excessive frugality, yet this is what he will receive.

**11:18** There is one who grows rich by his stinginess, and this is his appointed portion:

**11:19** When he says, "I have found rest, and now I will eat of my goods" — he does not know how much time will pass until he leaves them to others and dies.

**11:20** Stand by your covenant and attend to it, and grow old in your work.

**11:21** Do not marvel at the works of a sinner, but trust in the LORD and remain in your labor; for it is easy in the eyes of the LORD to enrich a poor man suddenly and swiftly.

**11:22** The blessing of the LORD is in the reward of the godly, and in an instant he causes his blessing to flourish.

**11:23** Do not say, "What do I need, and what good things will come to me in the future?"

**11:24** Do not say, "I have enough, and what harm can come to me now?"

**11:25** In the day of good things, evil things are forgotten; and in the day of evil things, good things are not remembered.

**11:26** For it is easy before the LORD to repay a man on the day of death according to his ways.

**11:27** The affliction of an hour causes one to forget pleasure, and at the end of a man his deeds will be revealed.

**11:28** Before death, do not call anyone blessed; and a man will be known by his end, how his children are.

**11:29** Do not bring every person into your house; for many are the snares of the deceitful.

**11:30** Like a decoy partridge in a cage, so is the heart of a proud man; and like a spy he looks out for your falling.

**11:31** For he lies in wait, turning good into evil, and to what is praiseworthy he will attach blame.

**11:32** From a single spark a great fire is kindled, and a sinful man lies in wait for blood.

**11:33** Beware of a bad person, for he contrives evil, lest he bring upon you a lasting blemish.

**11:34** Receive a stranger into your home and he will create trouble for you, and will estrange you from your own household.
